title: 139th Wimbledon 2026: Jannik Sinner Wins Men's Singles; Linda Nosková Wins Women's Singles
summary: Jannik Sinner defeats Alexander Zverev to claim 2nd consecutive Wimbledon and 5th Grand Slam title.

blocks.content: Jannik Sinner defeats Alexander Zverev to claim 2nd consecutive Wimbledon and 5th Grand Slam title.

items: Men's Singles Winner: Jannik Sinner (Italy) defeated Alexander Zverev (Germany).
Women's Singles Winner: Linda Nosková (Czech Republic) defeated Karolína Muchová.
Sinner Milestone: 2nd consecutive Wimbledon title and 100th Grand Slam match victory.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: Wimbledon played on grass courts at All England Club, London (established 1877).

blocks.content: Men's Singles Winner (Jannik Sinner) vs Women's Singles Winner (Linda Nosková).
